title: The Spectral Topology of Global Imbalances:A Graph-Theoretic Framework for Systemic Risk in the Balance of Payments
authors: V. N. S. R. Murthy Duggirala
summary: We model global balance-of-payments linkages as a directed weighted exposure network and study systemic fragility through the spectrum of the associated operators. From a signed bilateral-flow matrix, we construct a nonnegative exposure lift, derive a spectral stability criterion for linear propagation, and define node- and edge-level risk measures using Perron-Frobenius geometry, PageRank, and marginal spectral impact.
